ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity pixels (approx. 85% of fluke area) and localized high-intensity white patches at the distal tips and scattered circular nodes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pixel region extending from the median notch to the sub-terminal areas of both lobes. High-intensity white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral margins (tips) of both lobes, with smaller isolated white circular nodes scattered across the black interior surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central notch with an approximate 70-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 50 pixels from the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and deep valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetry with a concave curvature originating at the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex curve that terminates at the highly irregular lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 15-20 discrete circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed primarily across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes, varying in diameter from 3 to 10 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible within the white high-intensity patch of the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-relief, high-intensity clusters at the extreme distal corners of both lobes consistent with external bio-fouling or calcified deposits.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, saw-tooth serration pattern on the left lobe leading edge area adjacent to the tip, exhibiting larger pixel-amplitude disruptions than the rest of the trailing edge.
